header.note: all coordinates are integers; multiply by scale to get metres. x = east, y = north, local transverse Mercator centred on P0 (see origin.json). Rings are flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...] without closing vertex; exterior CCW, holes CW. Heights in the same integer units (0.1 m).
source: NYC Open Data BUILDING footprints (5zhs-2jue): footprints, height_roof (ft->m), ground_elevation
NYC 3D Building Model 2014 (DoITT, CityGML LOD2, DA13): roof tiers (building parts)
NYC Planimetric Database: Roadbed (i36f-5ih7), Sidewalk (52n9-sdep), Median (ees7-4ufv), Public Plazas (ue2e-9jm2), Open Space Parks (y6ja-fw4f), Hydrography (pjs3-c3z5)
OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Overpass API: road/path centrelines, crossings, park landcover, water, fountains, Central Park trees, Met outline

schema.buildings: [h_roof, h_min, ground_elev, bin, feature_code, year, polygons, parts]; polygons = [[outer, hole...], ...]; parts = [[h_roof, h_min, [outer, hole...]], ...] roof tiers from the 3D model (non-overlapping, together ~ the footprint). h_* relative to ground.
schema.roads: [class, name_index, width, oneway, lanes, line]  width measured from NYC roadbed polygons (median perpendicular cross-section) or class default
schema.trees: [x, y, dbh_in, canopy_radius, species_index, source]  source 0 = 2015 census street tree, 1 = OSM natural=tree (dbh 0 = unknown, radius default 4 m). canopy_radius = 0.5*(1.5 + 0.2*DBH_cm) m, clamped 1..14 m
schema.met: name, bin, outline (OSM relation 3698894), steps polygon (DERIVED, see note)

header.met_steps_note: No steps polygon exists in OSM or NYC planimetrics. Derived: the plaza strip between the inner edges of the two Met fountains (OSM ways 552699591/552699597), from the fountains' curb-side edge up to the Met facade (NYC footprint), clipped to the NYC public-plaza polygon. Approximate.
header.trees_note: Central Park interior trees are only those mapped individually in OSM (natural=tree); most park canopy is represented by OSM natural=wood polygons (areas.wood).
